item.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
item.description: The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.

item.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
item.description: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

item.title: Can luxury save Macy's?
item.description: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

item.title: 'All of a Sudden' is over 3 hours long. Our critic can't wait to see it a third time
item.description: Justin Chang says this is the best movie he's seen all year. It follows a friendship between two women in Paris — one runs an elder-care facility; the other is a theater director visiting from Kyoto.

item.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
item.description: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.
